name: talaria-mcp
description: MCP server exposing Talaria's safe agent tools (create/triage tickets — never assign or complete)

scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored but IS what runs (the app spawns dist/index.js). npm runs `prepare` after `npm install`/`npm ci` here, so installing this package can never leave you without a dist — the last line of defence behind scripts/setup.sh, scripts/dev.sh and CI.
